answers.explanation: A subnet is just a network that was carved out of a bigger one. To a router it's one more network to forward to.
Different subnets are different networks, so the host sends to its default gateway and the router forwards it.
Broadcasts stop at the router. Smaller subnets mean each broadcast reaches fewer hosts.
Subnetting controls traffic, organization, and security. It doesn't make anyone's internet link faster.
Hosts on the same subnet talk directly, so their traffic never passes through a router. Subnetting creates the place to put the rule.
The broadcast stays on the sender's subnet, so it reaches the roughly 250 hosts there.
Using an octet to encode the floor or department is what makes a plan organized: you can read the address and know where it lives.
